solutions.title: Copy values into a reversed chain
solutions.strategy: Collect node values into an array, then build a new linked list while reading that array from right to left.

timeComplexity.explanation: The algorithm scans the input chain once and rebuilds one node for each collected value.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The value array and rebuilt chain both scale with the number of nodes.

solutions.title: In-place pointer reversal
solutions.strategy: Walk the chain once, reversing each node's next pointer toward the already-reversed prefix.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is visited and rewired exactly once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only previous, current, and next references are maintained while the existing nodes are reused.
